offerText: The full deal archive — for your records, a dispute, or court proceedings in your jurisdiction
formatPdfHint: A report with a table of contents — coming soon. For now the package includes index.html: print it to PDF from any browser
formatZipHint: The evidence package with a hash manifest + the files as a separate archive
artifactPackageText: manifest.json, SHA256SUMS, README, index.html and timestamps. Kilobytes — kept indefinitely.
artifactFilesText: Evidence originals and thumbnails — for the retention period.
filesPending: The files are still being assembled
filesNotRequested: Files were not requested — manifest only
filesShredded: The files were deleted on {{date}} when the retention period ended
filesShreddedPackageOk: The package with the hashes is still available — files you downloaded earlier can be verified
linkRevokedHint: Your link has been revoked — rebuild the archive to get a new one
verifyCompactText: The package includes a hash manifest, timestamps and instructions. You can verify integrity yourself, without the platform.
verifyStep1: Unpack package.zip (and files.zip, if you downloaded it) into one folder
verifyStep2: In that folder run the command for your system:
verifyStep3: Every line should end with “OK”. “FAILED” means the file was changed; “MISSING” means it is not in the unpacked folder — that is not a mismatch
verifyStep4: The details and the expert path — the Audit Vault chain, the RFC 3161 timestamp — are in README.txt inside the package
verifyWhyText: If only the platform can confirm integrity, it’s an interested witness. The manifest removes that question.
verifyNoHashes: Hashes appear once the package is built
optionsGroupLabel: What to include in the archive
optionManifestOnlyHint: A list and hashes of the files, without the files themselves — the lightest option
snapshotText: The deal isn’t closed yet. The package will be a snapshot as of {{time}}
exportCtaHint: Free · ZIP with a hash manifest
generatingHint: You can leave — you’ll get a notification when it’s ready
nothingToExport: Nothing to build yet: the contract has never been frozen
optionsConflict: Choose one option: either the originals or the manifest only
exportsEmpty: No exports yet — build the first one
linksText: Each party received its own links: they need no sign-in and outlive the files. Revoke yours if the email ended up in the wrong hands.
linkOther: The other party’s link — only they can see the address
linkOpenFallback: The app opened from a saved copy. Download the archive using the link below, then refresh the page (Ctrl+Shift+R).
revokeConfirmText: The link will stop opening for everyone who has it. The package and files stay in place — the next build issues a new link.
retentionNotStarted: The deal is in progress — the file retention countdown starts after it ends
retentionHotUntil: Files open in the deal card until {{date}}
retentionShredded: The retention period has ended — the originals were deleted. Hashes and the evidence package remain available indefinitely
retentionPaused: A dispute is open — deletion is postponed
emptyText: The contract hasn’t been frozen yet — build the archive after sending it for signature
title: Archive export
